nodes.label: Composite.frag
nodes.rationale: Final bloom stage: combines the full-res HDR scene with the blurred quarter-res bloom mask, applies exposure and tone mapping, writes to the swapchain.

nodes.label: Bilinear upsample of the bloom mask
nodes.rationale: Composite samples the quarter-res bloomTex at full-res uv and relies on the sampler's bilinear filtering, which also softens the blur's own quarter-res blockiness.

nodes.label: Luminance-divide tone mapping (c / (Y+1))
nodes.rationale: Divides by luminance rather than per-channel (which would desaturate highlights to white); kept byte-identical to CookTorrance.frag's tone map (L09 s.45) so bloom and direct-lit highlights compress the same way.

nodes.label: LIGHT_DEBUG_NO_TONEMAP shared debug bit
nodes.rationale: A constant from custom/LightConstants.glsl, shared with SceneLights.hpp and CookTorrance.frag, so one cheat-menu toggle skips the tone map on both direct lighting and bloom together.

nodes.label: Hardware sRGB encode on the swapchain
nodes.rationale: Composite writes linear color because the swapchain is B8G8R8A8_SRGB and the hardware does the linear-to-sRGB encode on write; a manual gamma curve here would double-encode and wash the image out.
